package http

import (
	"encoding/hex"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

// 生成 kite tests/go/testdata/http/wire.txt：reqTests / badRequestTests / respTests 的原始报文 + 补充用例
func TestDumpWire(t *testing.T) {
	var out []string
	h := func(s string) string { return hex.EncodeToString([]byte(s)) }
	for _, tt := range reqTests {
		out = append(out, "req|"+h(tt.Raw))
	}
	for _, tt := range badRequestTests {
		out = append(out, "req|"+h(string(tt.req)))
	}
	for _, tt := range respTests {
		m := "GET"
		if tt.Resp.Request != nil {
			m = tt.Resp.Request.Method
		}
		out = append(out, "resp|"+h(m)+"|"+h(tt.Raw))
	}
	for _, x := range wireExtra {
		p := []string{x[0]}
		for _, a := range x[1:] {
			p = append(p, h(a))
		}
		out = append(out, strings.Join(p, "|"))
	}
	os.WriteFile(os.Getenv("OUT"), []byte(strings.Join(out, "\n")+"\n"), 0o644)
}
